instruction: Manufacturing Capability Check The file `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb` has tracks at 0.10 mm width and vias with 0.20 mm drill, both below the 2-layer manufacturer capability floor. The file `/home/user/Desktop/jlc_2layer.yaml` specifies the minimums. Update every track width and via size in `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb` to meet or exceed the minimums in `/home/user/Desktop/jlc_2layer.yaml`. Preserve routing topology: every segment must keep identical start/end coordinates and net assignment. Only widths and via dimensions may change. Requirements: 1. Every segment width must be at least `min_trace_mm`. 2. Every via drill must be at least `min_via_drill_mm`, and every via diameter must be at least `min_via_diameter_mm`. 3. Every via annular ring, `(diameter - drill) / 2`, must be at least `min_annular_mm`. 4. Segment count and via count must remain identical to the input. 5. Each segment's `(start, end, net)` tuple must remain unchanged, and each via's `(x, y, net)` tuple must remain unchanged. 6. Also write `/home/user/Desktop/fcu.svg` as the native KiCad CLI F.Cu SVG export of your final board. Write `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb` and `/home/user/Desktop/fcu.svg`. [Software] To use KiCad, run `kicad` for the GUI or `kicad-cli` for scripting/headless use (use PATH or the full install path).
